description: Unsigned transactions settling a stock's same-day series after their 4:00 p.m. New York close: prove the closing price from the stock's Chainlink feed (the last print at or before the close, found by walking back from the latest round) if nobody has, then settle every open series of that close. Gives the closing price, its proof and what each series pays an option. Seven days after a close with no price to prove it builds the void instead. Anyone may send these; a keeper or any agent can run this once a day.

date.description: Only the close of this trading day, like 2026-11-24 (optional; default every close still waiting)

symbol.description: A stock with same-day options, by its ticker, like NVDA

wallet.description: The address that will send it (any address)

name: settle_0dte
title: Prepare: settle same-day options after the close
